propositions: Findings raised on one patchset and not re-emitted on the next are lost to consumers because payloads are keyed by (change_id, revision) and code-review artifacts are emitted per revision only.
Unresolved findings must be injected into fresh patchsets carrying state (still-present/addressed/withdrawn) and origin metadata (prior revision, prior decision bucket) to prevent false negatives.

Carry-forward is gated by eligibility: only surfaced findings with non-empty evidence are eligible, and unresolvable regions default to still-present because the posture clamp can only lower a decision.
Each standing item is carried at most once; a re-raised carried item is marked withdrawn, bounding the recall chain to a single patchset.

Carried findings are injected post-Pass-1 via a new standing_findings workflow input and merged into fresh Pass-1 output only if their norm_id was not re-emitted, without changing finder behavior or raising a posture above the prior decision.
